task-dependencies.title: Task dependencies
task-dependencies.intro: Plan the order of delivery across the whole project. Edit predecessor relationships on the canvas or in the list, then save the draft together.
task-dependencies.boundary: These are delivery dependencies between business tasks. Saving does not dispatch tools, start an execution workflow or approve delivery.
task-dependencies.direction: Predecessor → successor · Select a task to edit its predecessors
task-dependencies.layout_failed: Automatic layout is unavailable. The graph and list remain usable.
task-dependencies.invalid_read: The server did not return a complete, consistent task graph. Editing is unavailable; read the graph again.
task-dependencies.pending: The original save has not been confirmed
task-dependencies.pending_help: The exact original request has been retained. Restore its result before editing again; a restore does not create a new save.
task-dependencies.saved: Saved. A new read confirmed the changed task versions and dependencies.
task-dependencies.review_help: Your draft is preserved. Read the latest graph, compare the edited tasks, then explicitly keep your changes on the new versions or discard the draft.
task-dependencies.ack_title: Save recorded; current graph needs review
task-dependencies.ack_help: The original save receipt is valid. It does not prove that these are still the current task versions. Read the graph and review any newer changes before continuing.
task-dependencies.comparison: Edited tasks only · compare before adopting new versions
task-dependencies.keep: Use latest versions and keep my changes
task-dependencies.use_latest: Use latest graph and discard draft
task-dependencies.rebased: Latest versions adopted. Your local changes are preserved; review them before saving.
task-dependencies.removed_task: An edited task has been removed or is no longer accessible. The draft is preserved; return to tasks or adopt the latest graph and discard the draft.
task-dependencies.access_changed: Current access could not be confirmed. Protected task details are hidden. Retry to read under your current access.
task-dependencies.limit_title: This project is larger than the graph editor limit
task-dependencies.limit: This project has {{total}} tasks; the graph editor supports up to {{limit}}. No partial graph is shown. Use the task list to edit individual tasks.
task-dependencies.empty_help: Create project tasks first, then return to plan their delivery order.
task-dependencies.stale: Project data changed while you were editing. Your draft has been retained; compare the latest graph before continuing.
task-dependencies.problem_cycle: These relationships contain a cycle. Remove a dependency to restore a valid delivery order.
task-dependencies.problem_self: A task cannot depend on itself.
task-dependencies.problem_missing: A predecessor is missing or no longer accessible. Remove its reference before saving.
task-dependencies.batch_limit: A save can change up to 100 tasks. Reduce the edited scope before saving; the platform will not split this draft automatically.
task-dependencies.predecessor_help: This task follows these predecessors. Use these controls as the keyboard alternative to drawing and deleting canvas connections.
